name: SuperIntern
description:
SuperIntern is an AI meeting assistant that records and transcribes your meetings without a bot joining the call. This connector brings your meeting knowledge directly into Claude.

What you can do:
- List your recent meetings and filter them by date range or project
- Pull full meeting transcripts into your conversation
- Get AI-generated summaries and meeting notes
- Follow live transcripts of meetings still in progress
- Browse the projects in your workspace

_published_faq.name: How do I add SuperIntern to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add SuperIntern to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.app.super-intern.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the SuperIntern MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: SuperIntern provides these MCP tools: account_get_context, meetings_get_live_transcript, meetings_get_metadata, meetings_get_note, meetings_get_summary, meetings_get_transcript, meetings_list, and projects_list.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to SuperIntern?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to SuperIntern in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
SuperIntern requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
SuperIntern is developed by NanoHuman Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
